c:
Thank you again, friend. I've been acquainting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.
I've heard... Less than charitable things about adventurers thus far in my travels. I'm pleased that those insinuations are quite unfounded.
You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.

d:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave adventurer. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.
Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
c: The land itself let me know ye were comin'! Aye, sometimes, the burnin' fire within us is enough to power us through the snow without even touchin' the ground!
